title: 高二短对话：兰花展与工具
source_notice: 高二银川标题公开阶段卷五短对话两遍/末尾十秒已核，不移借高一单遍。源录音/脚本/听力键缺，后文阅读1—5答案不能移作听力键；原校身份未认证。本稿完整原创配套非来源gold或独立难度验证。
instruction: 听五段独立短对话，每段一题，从A、B、C中选最佳答案。每段两遍，听后留10秒。本机可重播供审阅，不作正式次数控制。

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Are you still entering the tennis match on Saturday?

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: I have withdrawn. The match clashes with the orchid show, and I promised my grandmother I would take her to see it.

questions.stem: What will the woman do on Saturday?
questions.rationale: A：已退出冲突的比赛且未安排观赛；B：明确陪祖母看兰花展；C：花展不是园艺比赛

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: We waited for you at the cafe. Did you forget our message?

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: I saw it, but I was repairing a chair and thought I could finish one last joint first. By the time I looked up, everyone had left.

questions.stem: Why did the man miss the meeting?
options: He was busy with a repair.
He did not receive the message.
He could not find the cafe.
questions.rationale: A：专心修椅延误；B：明确看到消息；C：没有迷路

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: What did you think of the biography?

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: The subject led an extraordinary life, but the writer managed to make every chapter feel like a list of dates. I kept putting it down.

questions.stem: What is the woman's opinion of the book?
questions.rationale: A：没有觉得好笑；B：人物有趣不等作者写得鼓舞人心；C：章节像日期清单且反复放下支持乏味

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: This message looks like it is from the bank, but it asks for my password.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Do not reply. Open the bank's app yourself and check there, rather than following the link in the message.

questions.rationale: A：不是选账户；B：索密码消息与独立核实支持防诈骗；C：未丢手机；虚构对话不作实际账户操作

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Cycling to work would save money, but that road has no cycle lane.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: So are you going to try it?

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Only if I can find a quieter route. I am not ready to share that narrow road with the morning traffic.

questions.stem: What is the man's attitude towards cycling to work?
questions.rationale: A：愿考虑但要求更安全路线；B：仅反对当前狭窄路线不是全面反对；C：没有决定明天开始
